card.name: Punctuation before sulfonylurea drug names
card.fires_on: Commas, parentheses, 'including', 'e.g.,' or 'of' placed just before a specific diabetes drug name such as glipizide, glyburide or glimepiride, in sulfonylurea or diabetes-drug lists.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.,' inside a list of sulfonylurea examples, right before the next drug name.

modes.description: 'including', 'of' or an opening parenthesis that leads into a specific antidiabetic drug name.
